fsid.description: Unique cluster identifier (UUID). Must be globally unique across clusters.

mon_initial_members.description: Initial monitor hostnames or identifiers for quorum formation.

mds_id.description: Unique identifier for this MDS daemon (e.g., 'a', 'b', '0').

mds_host.description: Hostname or IP address for this MDS daemon to bind to. If empty, auto-detected.

mds_rank.description: MDS rank (0-based). Set manually only for static rank assignment; omit or leave null for dynamic.

mds_max_file_size.description: Maximum file size (in bytes) allowed in CephFS (default: 1 TiB).

mds_standby.description: Enable standby mode (true) so daemon waits for active MDS failure to take over.

mds_standby_for_name.description: Name of MDS daemon this standby follows. Empty means standby for any rank.

mds_standby_replay.description: Enable replay mode: standby MDS replays log in real-time to reduce failover latency.

mds_cache_memory_limit.description: Memory limit (in bytes) for metadata cache per MDS instance (default: 1 GiB).

mds_dir_max_entries.description: Maximum entries allowed per directory before performance tuning needed.

mds_decay_halflife.description: Time (in seconds) for cache decay halflife (higher = longer cache retention).

mds_beacon_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between MDS beacon messages to monitor daemons.

mds_beacon_grace.description: Grace period (in seconds) before an unresponsive MDS is marked failed.

mds_enforce_unique_name.description: Enforce unique MDS names (prevents duplicate ranks).

mds_op_complaint_time.description: Time (in seconds) before an operation is considered slow and logged.

mds_op_log_debug_time.description: Time (in seconds) after which debug logs for ops are truncated.

mds_op_log_max_items.description: Maximum operations logged per MDS instance.

mds_replay_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) for MDS journal replay attempts during recovery.

mds_verify_scatter_noscatter.description: Verify consistency between scatter and noscatter metadata modes (diagnostic).

client_cache_size.description: Client-side cache size (in bytes) per mount (default: 1 GiB).

client_readahead_min.description: Minimum read-ahead (in bytes) for sequential reads (default: 1 MiB).

client_readahead_max.description: Maximum read-ahead (in bytes) for sequential reads (default: 60 MiB).

client_snapshots.description: Enable client-side snapshot support (requires compatible client kernel).

enable_cephfs_ganesha.description: Enable NFS-Ganesha export for Samba/NFS-compatible access (requires cephfs-ganesha package).

ganesha_mount_dir.description: Mount point path under which Ganesha exposes CephFS (relative to Ganesha root).

nfs_exports.description: List of NFS export paths and their corresponding CephFS backing paths (for Ganesha).
